thread:
sam: Kicking off RC-29 origination now. artifact=rc-2026.07-29 (sha: 9f1d2c3). Quick sanity-check on release notes and rollback plan?
elaine: Running preflight (smoke + integ) against staging, ETA ~5m.
deploy-bot: Preflight started: id=preflight-4551234567.
nate: Preflight green except kv service shows a couple 502s on first hits (cold prefixes).
viv: I'll run a KV warm job after we pin; should mitigate cold-starts.
sam: Rollback plan: revert to rc-28 (rc-2026.06-10 sha: e8c4b9a). Steps: 1) deploybot promote rc-28, 2) smoke, 3) restore flags and open incident if needed. Approve?
ops-sheriff: Ack. I'll own rollback decision during promo window 01:00-03:00 UTC.
sam: Pinning artifact now.
Command: deploybot pin --artifact rc-2026.07-29 --env prod --by sam --reason "RC-29 origination"
deploy-bot: Pin request received. verification passed. Artifact pinned to candidate slot.
viv: KV warm job running on candidate nodes.
viv: Warm complete, no 502s observed.
sam: Starting staged promo: 3% canary for 10m -> 20% 10m -> 100%. Nate will watch telemetry.
deploy-bot: Promo started. canary=3% duration=10m id=promo-4551234567.
4m in: nate: small error spike in eu-west cluster, 5xx ~0.8%, investigating.
viv: Reducing canary to 1% and enabling tighter telemetry guard (abort if 5xx > 0.5% for 3m).
deploy-bot: Traffic updated to 1%.
2m later: nate: error rate normalized to baseline. No DB or network anomalies.
sam: Proceeding to 20% after watch period.
deploy-bot: Traffic updated to 20%.
10m at 20%: nate: stable. Moving to 100%.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. expected completion ~3m.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All prod routes now serving rc-2026.07-29.
sam: Post-promo smoke: all checks green. Publishing release notes and tagging: https://git.redwood/release-notes/rc-29
ops-sheriff: Staying on-call for 60m. Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx > 0.6% for 3m OR p95 latency > 500ms.
sam: Thanks team. Closing thread — ping #eng-oncall if anything comes up. :shipit:
